title: Everyday Phrases — Gym Workout
scene_zh: 健身房鍛煉 · 情境對話
title_quote: Hi, I want to join the gym.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏋️ 實用健身房鍛煉必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Gym Workout
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用健身房鍛煉情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從前台問月卡年費、預約體測、領毛巾手環與儲物櫃、人太多要排隊，到教練問增肌減脂目標、跑步機熱身拉伸、認識器械區、調座椅與重量、看動作示範，再到深蹲臥推划船做組、組間休息呼吸、請人幫忙保護、共用器械、擦汗歸位，最後結束拉伸、沖蛋白粉、淋浴更衣、冰敷痠痛、約下次並買課程，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Gym Workout phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), following a beginner's first day: asking the front desk about monthly and yearly fees, booking a body test, grabbing a towel, wristband and locker, then setting muscle and fat-loss goals with the coach, warming up on the treadmill, learning the weight room, adjusting seats and plates; after that squat, bench and row sets, resting between sets, asking someone to spot you, sharing machines and wiping weights back; and at the end cool-down stretches, protein shakes, the shower, ice packs for soreness, and signing up for the next session. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I want to join the gym.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ, aɪ wɑnt tə dʒɔɪn ðə dʒɪm./
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想加入這間健身房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great! I can show you around.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much do you charge a month?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ du ju tʃɑrdʒ ə mʌnθ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is thirty dollars a month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the basic plan include?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you do a body test first?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju du ə ˈbɑdi tɛst fɜrst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, every new member takes one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, I wrote your name down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what happens at the test?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I wear these old ones?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old shoes slip, bring better ones.
dialogue.zh: 舊鞋會打滑，換一雙來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is my form, all done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is this small card for?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這個手環是我的鑰匙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep it safe all day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I store my bag there?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the locker have a lock?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone goes in the locker.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a few minutes, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bikes over there are open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我可以先看別人怎麼用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We close at ten at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill your bottle by the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 朋友可以偶爾來當訪客嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One guest a week is fine.
dialogue.zh: 一週帶一位客人沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I cancel if I dislike it?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈkænsəl ɪf aɪ dɪsˈlaɪk ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a map of the gym?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə mæp əv ðə dʒɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take one from the front desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是啊，音樂讓人更有幹勁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I train before the test?
dialogue.zh: 體測前我就能先訓練嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 當然，體測不會影響安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tour first, then the floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need my ID again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show it once, that is all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your band is active now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can two people share one pass?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay for a towel?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, towels are free to use.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This band looks like a toy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Members skip it, you have a band.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛmbərz skɪp ɪt, ju həv ə bænd./
dialogue.zh: 會員不用排隊，你有手環。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I book a class now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在能約一堂團課嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I signed up for one year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, my first day starts now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you as well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I want to build some muscle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you also want to lose fat?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ˈɔlsoʊ wɑnt tə luz fæt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my belly is too soft.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will skip heavy knee moves.
dialogue.zh: 那我們避開傷膝的動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this is my first time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the treadmill or the bike?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many minutes should I walk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I run on this later?
dialogue.zh: 之後我能在這上面跑嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 很快就能跑，今天先走路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oops, I pressed the wrong button!
dialogue.zh: 慘了，我按到錯的按鈕了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, I will slow it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn, aɪ wɪl sloʊ ɪt daʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What does the red button do?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now stretch your arms up high.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I stretch my legs too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us walk to the weights.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And that one for my back?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, that one works your arms.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit down and face the pad.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I feel it in my back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull this lever to lift it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Will you show me once more?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在照我的速度，一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Control is harder than I thought.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next, we add one more machine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不要那台高高的大機器！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好吧，那台留著以後再練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 每個動作四組，還是少一點？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two sets are plenty for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 雙腳打開，約胯部那麼寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I look down or ahead?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not let them cave in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I lie all the way down?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ laɪ ɔl ðə weɪ daʊn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bar is right above me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me when to take it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you mind if we share it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju maɪnd ɪf wi ʃɛr ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你介意我們共用這台嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, we can take turns.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time your rests, do not drift.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, but I am breathing hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My shirt is all wet now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe the bench too, when done.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Into the bin by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will dry my hands first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, weights live on the rack.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I need the ten pound pair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, once I can walk!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My legs are so tight now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這樣明天會比較不痠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How hard should I shake it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這裡的巧克力味還不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it okay to drink now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Past the lockers, on the right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tie it up, it dries fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I use an ice pack?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我下次上課是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay for that today?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use it twice weekly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以，一週兩次剛好用完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think I will buy it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, I will add it today.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我今天先幫你加上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How soon will I see results?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need rest days too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to come back daily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soon I will be in shape.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am glad I came today.
